data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental with no license needed in 2027? You’re in the right place. We break down every cost, from the cheapest 2-hour cruise (€749) to a full-day luxury charter on a 24m Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours). All prices include a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA — no surprises. Whether you’re celebrating, sightseeing, or just escaping the heat, our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and covers the Costa del Sol from Estepona to Cabopino.

Why No License Boat Rentals Work in Marbella

Spanish law requires a license for any boat over a certain length or power, but you don’t need one when you charter a crewed vessel. Every boat in our fleet comes with a fully licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You simply turn up, board, and enjoy. This makes it ideal for tourists, groups, and anyone who wants a stress-free day on the water.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Tier A boats: €749/2h → €2,299/8h. Tier B (Mangusta 80): €4,719 minimum 4h.

Tier A: Best Value for Small Groups (€749–€2,299)

If you’re a group of up to 9–11 people, the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are the most affordable no-license options. Both are 12.5m flybridge cruisers with sun pads, a shaded saloon, and a bathroom. At €749 for 2 hours, you can cruise past the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro, and sip cava. For a full day (8 hours), it’s €2,299 — perfect for a round trip to Estepona or Sotogrande.

Tier B: Mangusta 80 – Premium with Jet Ski (from €4,719)

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is our flagship for those who want space and speed. The minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, and that includes a free jet ski towed behind. You can waterski, wakeboard, or just lounge on the massive foredeck. Both white and grey hull variants are available. This is the choice for birthdays, corporate events, or anyone who wants to arrive in style at Marbella Marina.

Other Boats in Our Fleet: Prices on Request

Beyond the two tiers, we offer a dozen more boats — from the 8m Dubhe (5 pax, ideal for couples) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax, full luxury). Because specifications vary widely, we provide pricing on request via WhatsApp. This ensures you get an accurate quote for your exact dates and needs. All still include skipper, fuel, drinks, and insurance.

What’s Included in Every No-License Charter

  • Licensed skipper (handles all navigation and safety)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, first aid)
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no added tax at checkout

Popular Routes from Puerto Banús

Most charters head west toward Estepona or east to Cabopino. A 2-hour trip often hugs the coast past the Golden Mile and stops at Cala del Faro for a swim. A 4-hour trip can reach Estepona port or the cliffs of Cala Cortés. Full-day (8h) charters can go as far as Sotogrande or even Gibraltar on calm days. Your skipper will suggest the best route based on weather and your preferences.

Book Your 2027 No-License Boat Rental

Ready to reserve? Check our full fleet on the Marbella boat rental homepage and pick your boat. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For others, message us on WhatsApp. Prices are locked for 2027 bookings made in advance — no last-minute hikes. Whether it’s a sunset cruise or a full-day adventure, we’ve got you covered.

Do I need a boating license to rent a boat in Marbella?

No. Every charter includes a licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You just relax and enjoy the coast.

The cheapest option is our Tier A boats: Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, from €749 for 2 hours. Both depart from Puerto Banús and accommodate up to 9–11 passengers.

All prices include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

For a full 8-hour day, Tier A boats cost €2,299. For larger vessels like the Mangusta 80, the minimum is 4 hours at €4,719. Contact us via WhatsApp for other boats.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks on board. The provided drinks and snacks complement what you bring.

Where do the boats depart from?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. This is the main departure point, with easy parking and access to the marina.

What is the maximum number of passengers?

Passenger capacity varies by boat. The smallest (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) take 5 people, while larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Maiora 26m take up to 12 passengers.

You can book directly on our website or contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least a few days in advance, especially during summer.
